title: Motion on a drawing
subtitle: Shapes that slide, turn and change shape, lines that draw on, and lines that flow

scenes.title: Why a² + b² = c²
scenes.narration: Four copies of one right triangle, with short sides a and b and long side c, sit inside a square whose side is a plus b.
scenes.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1500 830">
<rect id="frame" x="80" y="70" width="700" height="700" fill="none" stroke="var(--muted)" stroke-width="3"/>
<rect id="a-sq" class="tone-warn" x="80" y="70" width="300" height="300"/>
<rect id="b-sq" class="tone-good" x="380" y="370" width="400" height="400"/>
<path id="c-sq" class="tone-accent" stroke-width="4" d="M380,70 L780,370 L480,770 L80,470 Z"/>
<polygon id="t1" class="tone-neutral" stroke-width="2" points="80,70 380,70 80,470"/>
<polygon id="t2" class="tone-neutral" stroke-width="2" points="380,70 780,70 780,370"/>
<polygon id="t3" class="tone-neutral" stroke-width="2" points="780,370 780,770 480,770"/>
<polygon id="t4" class="tone-neutral" stroke-width="2" points="480,770 80,770 80,470"/>
<text id="c-label" x="430.0" y="442.0" text-anchor="middle" font-size="64" fill="var(--accent)">c²</text>
<text id="a-label" x="230.0" y="240.0" text-anchor="middle" font-size="56" fill="var(--warn)">a²</text>
<text id="b-label" x="580.0" y="590.0" text-anchor="middle" font-size="64" fill="var(--good)">b²</text>
<g font-size="34" fill="var(--muted)" text-anchor="middle"><text x="230.0" y="54">a</text><text x="580.0" y="54">b</text><text x="56" y="282.0">b</text><text x="56" y="632.0">a</text></g>
<text id="area" x="900" y="320" font-size="40">(a + b)² = c² + 4 triangles</text>
<text id="area2" x="900" y="400" font-size="40" fill="var(--muted)">(a + b)² = a² + b² + 4 triangles</text>
</svg>

steps.say: The space they leave in the middle is a tilted square on the long side, so its area is c squared.
Now slide three of the triangles. None of them turns, and the big square stays the same.
The space left is now two squares, one on side a and one on side b.
The same four triangles left both spaces, so c squared equals a squared plus b squared.

scenes.title: Filling a tank
scenes.narration: A pipe fills a tank, and a gauge beside it reads the level.
scenes.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1400 700">
<path id="pipe" class="flow" stroke="var(--accent)" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round" d="M60 140 H360 Q420 140 420 200 V230"/>
<rect id="tank" x="380" y="220" width="400" height="420" rx="18"/>
<path id="water" class="tone-accent" d="M392 580 H768 V628 H392 Z"/>
<path id="water-full" d="M392 300 Q486 280 580 300 T768 300 V628 H392 Z"/>
<circle cx="1080" cy="420" r="190"/>
<g stroke="var(--muted)" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"><line x1="1080" y1="250" x2="1080" y2="280" transform="rotate(-60 1080 420)"/><line x1="1080" y1="250" x2="1080" y2="280"/><line x1="1080" y1="250" x2="1080" y2="280" transform="rotate(60 1080 420)"/></g>
<text x="880" y="300" font-size="34" fill="var(--muted)" text-anchor="middle">empty</text><text x="1280" y="300" font-size="34" fill="var(--muted)" text-anchor="middle">full</text>
<g id="needle" transform="rotate(-60 1080 420)"><line x1="1080" y1="420" x2="1080" y2="270" stroke="var(--warn)" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="1080" cy="420" r="18" fill="var(--warn)" stroke="none"/></g>
</svg>

steps.say: Water runs in along the pipe.
The level rises, and the needle swings round to full.
Shut the pipe and drain the tank, and both go back.
